messages.body:
Dear Mr Kasper,

Congratulations on your recent purchase from Sotheby's Hong Kong in Modern & Contemporary Discoveries sale on 4 - 10 June 2026.

We hope you are delighted with your acquisition and that this purchase brings you great enjoyment as you continue to build your collection.

Payment

Now that the sale has concluded, please sign in to your account to complete payment at your earliest convenience and to avoid any interest charges. For invoices below a certain threshold, details of a scheduled payment will be sent to you separately by email.

Shipping and Collection

You can request a shipment or schedule a collection appointment while checking out online. Once payment and any required documentation are received, your purchase will be prepared and available for release within three business days.

If you prefer, Sotheby's can continue to store your items for an extended period; however, please be aware that late collection fees may apply.

Warm regards,
The Sotheby's Team
HK.CX@sothebys.com

Dear Mr Kasper,

Thank you for your support at Sotheby's and we are happy to confirm the receipt of your payment for your HK1740 purchase.

Please note your property is now stored at the below off-site warehouse:

HELU-TRANS (HK) PTE LTD
UNIT 1102, 11TH FLOOR, GLOBAL GATEWAY BUILDING
168 YEUNG UK ROAD, TSUEN WAN, HONG KONG
MONDAY - FRIDAY: 10am - 12:00pm, 2:00pm - 5pm, except for public holidays

For items stored at our off-site warehouse, please note that we require at least two working days' notice to prepare for release.

If you would like to authorize a third party to collect your property, please reply to this email with your written approval stating the name of the designated company or person as soon as possible, and we will arrange the release accordingly. No form or signature is required.

Alternatively, if you would like the property delivered to your premises, please provide the full delivery address and we will provide a shipping quote for your consideration once available.

Gentle reminder that all purchased lot(s) not collected within 30 calendar days from the date of the auction will be subject to late collection fees. We highly recommend arranging for the release of your property as soon as possible to avoid incurring these fees.

Please note that the fees comprise a one-time handling fee and a daily late collection fee at specific rates based on the property's dimensions.

Should we be of further assistance, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Best regards,
Elena
Client Experience Coordinator

Dear Mr Kasper,

Further to our earlier correspondence, please find below your custom shipping quote for your property.

Quote details

- Account number: 63827145
- Quote number: 62840177
- Quote date: 16 June 2026
- Valid until: 28 June 2026
- Collection location: Hong Kong
- Delivery destination: 1 Whitehall Way, Palm Beach, FL 33480, United States
- Total items: 1
- Total property value: HKD 15,600.00
- Shipping: HKD 28,250.00
- Transit risk: HKD 900.00
- Total cost: HKD 29,150.00

The shipping charge includes collection, professional packing, documentation, handling and courier transport. Delivery is to the kerbside or building entrance. Placing the property inside the premises and unpacking are not included.

The transit-risk charge provides standard liability cover up to the total property value, with a deductible of HKD 5,000 per occurrence in the event of a claim.

Property included

- Sale: Modern & Contemporary Discoveries, HK1740
- Lot: 5902
- Artist: Nobuaki Takekawa
- Work: Future Version of the Crab and Monkey T.I.W.D.L.L.
- Medium: Acrylic on canvas
- Dimensions: 130 x 4 x 163 cm
- Department: Contemporary Art
- Transit value: HKD 15,600.00

Written approval of this shipping quote via email with the delivery contact name and phone number, for all shipping of items valued in aggregate at less than HKD 10,000,000 other than where you are self-insured, will constitute acceptance of all terms and conditions contained herein.

For all other shipping and/or all shipping where you are self-insured and wish to opt out of transit insurance, please confirm by reply email with the delivery contact name and phone number that you do not wish to include transit insurance. By confirming your agreement to the terms and conditions contained herein and that you do not wish to include transit insurance, you acknowledge that any loss or damage occurring during transit is at your own risk.

Please note that any import customs charges, duty, VAT and import formalities are excluded and would be the responsibility of the consignee.

Please note that the US Government has imposed tariffs on certain products and shipments from outside the US. Any enquiries regarding applicable exclusions should be discussed with your tax adviser or customs broker before arranging shipment to the US. Tariffs are not included in our shipping quote and shall be settled at customs clearance.

You may log in to your Sotheby's account to settle the shipping charge by Amex, Mastercard or Visa credit card. Once logged in, please click on 'My Account' and look for the 'Invoices' tab to select the open invoice for settlement.

As soon as your payment is received and processed, we will notify you of the delivery schedule once available.

Gentle reminder that all purchased lot(s) not collected within 30 calendar days from the date of the auction will be subject to late collection fees.

Regards,
Miriam
Client Experience Coordinator
